sources.entry: flask-debugtoolbar - A port of the django-debug-toolbar to Flask.

summary.one_liner: A Flask extension that injects a debugging sidebar with configurable information panels into rendered HTML pages, ported from django-debug-toolbar.
summary.what_it_does: Adds a debug toolbar to Flask apps by injecting debugging information into rendered HTML pages, shown as a sidebar. The toolbar is configured through panels that each display a category of information. It is set up by creating a DebugToolbarExtension object around the Flask app. According to the README, the toolbar is automatically injected into Jinja templates when debug mode is enabled. The README describes it as a port of django-debug-toolbar. The README does not list the specific panels.
use_cases: debug Flask applications in the browser
inspect rendered template and request information during development
view debugging panels alongside a web page
troubleshoot Flask apps running in debug mode
notable: Injects into Jinja templates automatically when debug mode is on
Part of the Pallets Community Ecosystem
caveats: Only active when Flask debug mode is enabled, per the README
README does not document the available panels or configuration options in detail
